entries.en: The team repeated the agrocin experiment after discovering a crack in the culture dish.
entries.zh: 发现培养皿有一道裂缝后，研究团队重做了土壤杆菌素实验。

entries.en: An unexpected peak appeared beside the agrocybin peak on the chromatogram.
entries.zh: 色谱图上，田头菇素峰旁边出现了一个意外的峰。

entries.en: The historian found two conflicting descriptions of Agrox in the factory's old correspondence.
entries.zh: 历史学家在工厂的旧通信中发现了关于苯汞脲的两种相互矛盾的描述。

entries.en: The care team kept his family informed during the long period of agrypnocoma.
entries.zh: 在他长时间处于醒态昏迷期间，医护团队持续向家属通报情况。

entries.en: She carried the jug of aguamiel to the shaded table without spilling a drop.
entries.zh: 她把那壶龙舌兰汁端到阴凉处的桌上，一滴也没洒。

entries.meaningZh: 阿瓜斯卡连特斯市〔墨西哥城市〕
entries.en: A relative mailed the parcel from the city of Aguascalientes but forgot to include a return address.
entries.zh: 一位亲戚从阿瓜斯卡连特斯市寄来了包裹，却忘记写上回邮地址。

entries.en: After unpacking the telescope, Aguinaldo discovered that its smallest screw was missing.
entries.zh: 打开望远镜的包装后，阿吉纳尔多发现它最小的那颗螺丝不见了。

entries.en: A sealed packet of agurin lay beside an old pharmacy ledger in the museum display.
entries.zh: 在博物馆的展柜里，一包密封的阿古林放在一本旧药房账簿旁。

entries.en: The aguti slipped behind a fallen branch before we could photograph it.
entries.zh: 我们还没来得及拍照，那只刺豚鼠就钻到了一根落枝后面。

entries.en: The neurologist asked for clearer images before discussing the extent of the agyria.
entries.zh: 神经科医生要求提供更清晰的图像，再讨论无脑回畸形涉及的范围。

entries.en: The researcher outlined the agyric area on the scan rather than shading the whole brain.
entries.zh: 研究者在扫描图像上勾出了无脑回区域，而没有给整个脑部涂上阴影。

entries.en: Her ahaptoglobinemia was already mentioned in the referral, alongside the laboratory results.
entries.zh: 转诊信中已经提到了她的缺触珠蛋白血症，并列出了化验结果。

entries.en: The illustrator sketched Ahasuerus in pencil before adding the background.
entries.zh: 插画师先用铅笔画出亚哈随鲁，再添加背景。

entries.en: Her ahedonia left her unable to enjoy the music she had once loved.
entries.zh: 快感缺失使她无法再从曾经喜爱的音乐中获得乐趣。

entries.en: The student measured the ahermatype specimen under a lamp before returning it to the tray.
entries.zh: 学生在灯下量了那份不造礁珊瑚标本，再把它放回盘里。

entries.en: Ahern spread a towel beneath the leaking pipe while I looked for a bucket.
entries.zh: 我找水桶时，埃亨在漏水的管子下面铺了一条毛巾。

entries.meaningZh: 自动化医院信息系统〔缩写AHIS〕
entries.en: Staff could not access the automated hospital information system (AHIS) during the upgrade.
entries.zh: 升级期间，工作人员无法访问自动化医院信息系统。

entries.en: The lecture compared two very different portrayals of Ahithophel.
entries.zh: 那堂课比较了两种截然不同的亚希多弗形象。

entries.en: A sketch of Ahmadabad filled the last two pages of her travel diary.
entries.zh: 一幅阿默达巴德的速写占满了她旅行日记的最后两页。

entries.en: She transcribed a short passage in Ahom from a damaged manuscript.
entries.zh: 她从一份受损的手稿中誊写了一小段阿霍姆语文字。

entries.en: She sought permission from the Ahousaht First Nation before reproducing the photographs.
entries.zh: 复制那些照片前，她先向阿豪沙特第一民族征求许可。

entries.en: The students compared drawings of Ahrensburgian tools before discussing the differences between them.
entries.zh: 学生们先比较了阿伦斯堡文化工具的绘图，然后讨论它们之间的差别。

entries.en: The postcard from Ahvaz arrived with one corner badly creased.
entries.zh: 从阿瓦士寄来的明信片收到时，有一个角皱得很厉害。

entries.en: The family packed the photographs taken in Ahwaz separately from the rest of their belongings.
entries.zh: 这家人把在阿瓦士拍的照片与其他物品分开装好。

entries.en: His ahypnia made the nights seem endless, though the clock ticked steadily beside him.
entries.zh: 他失眠时觉得长夜漫漫，尽管身旁的钟一直有节奏地滴答作响。

entries.en: She mentioned her ahypnosis only after describing several nights with almost no sleep.
entries.zh: 她先说自己连续几晚几乎没睡，之后才提到自己失眠的情况。

entries.meaningZh: 5-氨基-4-甲酰胺咪唑核糖核苷酸〔此处指核苷酸〕
entries.en: The team measured the ribonucleotide AICAR in both samples before comparing the reaction mixtures.
entries.zh: 研究团队先测定了两份样品中的AICAR核糖核苷酸，再比较反应混合物。

entries.meaningZh: 刀锋恐惧症；尖锐物恐惧症
entries.en: His aichmophobia made him leave the kitchen when someone began sharpening a knife.
entries.zh: 他有尖锐物恐惧症，有人开始磨刀时，他便离开了厨房。

entries.en: The physician's old notes on aidoiitis were hard to read because the ink had faded.
entries.zh: 由于墨迹褪色，那位医生关于外阴炎的旧笔记很难辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 异常强烈的性欲〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old report discussed aidoiomania without recording any account from the woman herself.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告讨论了异常强烈的性欲，却没有记录那位女性本人的任何陈述。

entries.meaningZh: 自动化输入与文档更新系统〔AIDUS历史系统名〕
entries.en: The historian compared two diagrams of the Automated Input and Document Updating System (AIDUS), but their dates were missing.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了自动化输入与文档更新系统（AIDUS）的两张图，但图上都没有日期。

entries.meaningZh: 臭椿属〔Ailanthus 的异体拼写〕
entries.en: An old drawing of Ailantus lay between two botanical catalogues on the desk.
entries.zh: 桌上两本植物目录之间放着一张臭椿属的旧绘图。

entries.en: At the follow-up appointment, the specialist photographed the toe affected by ainhum.
entries.zh: 复诊时，专科医生给那根患有阿洪病的脚趾拍了照。

entries.meaningZh: 阿伊努语〔旧文献拼法 Aino〕
entries.en: The old manuscript contained passages in Aino, but no translation accompanied them.
entries.zh: 那份旧手稿含有一些阿伊努语段落，却没有附上译文。

entries.en: A letter posted in Aintab reached the family long after they had moved.
entries.zh: 一封从艾因塔布寄出的信，在这家人搬走很久以后才送到。

entries.en: An Ainu photographer lent three prints to the exhibition and helped arrange the lighting.
entries.zh: 一位阿伊努族摄影师向展览出借了三张摄影作品，并帮忙布置灯光。

entries.en: The air-bed lost so much air overnight that I woke up almost touching the floor.
entries.zh: 充气床垫一夜漏了很多气，我醒来时几乎贴到了地板。

entries.en: The leaflet discussed air-borne infection without identifying a particular disease.
entries.zh: 那份宣传单讨论了通过空气传播的感染，但没有指明某一种疾病。

entries.en: The two soil samples differed in air-conductivity even though they looked equally dry.
entries.zh: 那两份土壤样本看起来同样干燥，透气性却不同。

entries.en: The sensor recorded a gradual rise in air-pressure after the chamber was closed.
entries.zh: 舱室关闭后，传感器记录到气压逐渐升高。

entries.en: She remembered the long flight mainly for its turbulence and her miserable air-sickness.
entries.zh: 回想那次长途飞行，她主要记得一路的颠簸和难受的晕机经历。

entries.en: She described frequent air-swallowing during meals when the doctor asked about her discomfort.
entries.zh: 医生问她有何不适时，她说吃饭时经常吞入空气。

entries.en: The museum's air-tester had been packed separately from the fragile glass equipment.
entries.zh: 博物馆那台大气碳酸计已与易碎的玻璃仪器分开包装。

entries.en: The student redrew the air-tube in her sketch after comparing two older anatomy illustrations.
entries.zh: 那名学生比较了两幅较早的解剖学插图后，重画了速写中的气管。

entries.en: The dentist asked the technician to inspect the airbrasive before the demonstration.
entries.zh: 牙医请技术员在演示前检查那台气压磨牙机。

entries.meaningZh: 乙酰半胱氨酸〔别名 airbron〕
entries.en: The chemist compared the airbron results with the records from the previous analysis.
entries.zh: 那位化学家将乙酰半胱氨酸的测定结果同上一次分析的记录作了比较。

entries.en: The airconditioner was still running when everyone else had left the office.
entries.zh: 其他人都离开办公室后，空调器还在运转。

entries.en: The old mine plan showed two airholes connecting the adjoining passages.
entries.zh: 那张旧矿井图标出了两个连接相邻巷道的通风联络孔。

entries.meaningZh: 阿伊罗尔〔旧药物名：碱式没食子酸碘铋〕
entries.en: The pharmacy museum kept the airol bottle sealed inside its original wooden case.
entries.zh: 药学博物馆把那瓶阿伊罗尔密封保存在原来的木盒中。

entries.en: After the move, the airometer was missing from the equipment shelf.
entries.zh: 搬迁后，设备架上的那台气流计不见了。

entries.en: Fine bubbles rose from the airstone and drifted towards the surface of the tank.
entries.zh: 细小的气泡从气石中冒出，慢慢升向水箱中的水面。

entries.meaningZh: 自动信息站系统〔历史AIST项目〕
entries.en: The historian compared two early plans for the automatic information station project AIST without assuming either was implemented.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了自动信息站系统项目 AIST 的两份早期方案，并未假定其中任何一份已得到实施。

entries.en: The chemist repeated the aizumycin analysis because the reference sample had been mislabeled.
entries.zh: 因为参比样品标错了，那位化学家重新分析了爱图霉素。

entries.meaningZh: 阿雅克修〔法国科西嘉岛城市〕
entries.en: We compared our faded photograph of Ajaccio with a much newer picture in the album.
entries.zh: 我们把那张褪色的阿雅克修照片与相册里一张新得多的照片作了比较。

entries.en: The remaining ajacine was set aside until the laboratory could confirm its purity.
entries.zh: 剩下的紫燕草碱乙被单独留存，等待实验室确认其纯度。

entries.en: The ajacol sample was returned unopened after the researcher cancelled the comparison.
entries.zh: 研究者取消比较分析后，那份乙氧基苯酚样品被原封不动地退回。

entries.en: She requested a fresh ajaconine sample because the original container had been damaged.
entries.zh: 因为原来的容器损坏了，她要求提供一份新的紫燕草碱甲样品。

entries.en: She brought a small packet of ajinomoto to the kitchen but left it unopened.
entries.zh: 她把一小包味精拿到厨房，却没有打开。

entries.en: The analyst checked the ajmalicine reference sample before interpreting the unfamiliar spectrum.
entries.zh: 分析员在解读那张不熟悉的谱图前，检查了阿吗碱对照样品。

entries.en: Their ajmaline measurements disagreed, so they compared the original laboratory notebooks.
entries.zh: 他们测得的阿义马林数据不一致，于是对照了原始实验记录本。

entries.en: The notebook she brought from Ajmer contained more drawings than written observations.
entries.zh: 她从阿杰梅尔带来的笔记本里，画图比文字观察记录还多。

entries.en: The researchers discussed whether the ajoene in the stored sample had changed during transport.
entries.zh: 研究者讨论了储存样品中的阿焦烯是否在运输途中发生了变化。

entries.en: The ajowan had spilled across the counter before she could close the packet.
entries.zh: 她还没来得及封好包装，印度藏茴香就撒到了台面上。

entries.en: An Akademi in India invited her to discuss the manuscripts she had catalogued.
entries.zh: 印度的一家学会邀请她谈谈自己编目整理过的那些手稿。

entries.en: Mina drew Akali twice before deciding which sketch to submit to the fan-art exhibition.
entries.zh: 米娜画了两次爱卡丽，然后才决定把哪张草图交给同人画展。

entries.en: The zoologist compared the akamushi specimen with an old drawing before revising the description.
entries.zh: 动物学家先把那件红恙虫标本与一幅旧图作比较，再修改描述。

entries.en: The students marked the akanthion on their drawings of the skull before comparing the measurements.
entries.zh: 学生们先在自己的颅骨绘图上标出了鼻前棘点，然后比较测量结果。

entries.en: The student sketched akaryota from the old histology slides and compared them with nucleated cells.
entries.zh: 那名学生根据旧组织切片绘制了无核细胞，并将其与有核细胞作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 慢性周围神经炎〔历史病名〕
entries.en: The historian compared two early reports of akatama and noticed different descriptions of the symptoms.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家比较了两份早期有关慢性周围神经炎的报告，发现它们对症状的描述不同。

entries.meaningZh: 自我理解不能〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The chapter on akatanoesis was missing from the psychiatrist's copy of the old textbook.
entries.zh: 那位精神科医生收藏的旧教科书缺少了讨论自我理解不能的一章。

entries.en: During the interview, his akathisia made remaining in the chair extremely difficult.
entries.zh: 谈话时，他的静坐不能症使他很难一直坐在椅子上。

entries.en: Several pages were missing from the old report on akembe, including the case summaries.
entries.zh: 那份关于阿肯病的旧报告缺了几页，其中包括病例摘要。

entries.meaningZh: 瘦果〔akene 为 achene 的异体拼法〕
entries.en: The akene rolled away when her tweezers touched the edge of the tray.
entries.zh: 她的镊子碰到托盘边缘时，那枚瘦果滚开了。

entries.en: The pathology report mentioned akeratosis but included no photographs of the tissue.
entries.zh: 那份病理报告提到了无角化，却没有附上组织照片。

entries.en: Akerlof recognised the tune before the musician had finished the opening phrase.
entries.zh: 乐手还没演奏完开头的乐句，阿克洛夫就认出了那支曲子。

entries.en: The Akhal-Teke waited by the open gate while its rider tightened a loose strap.
entries.zh: 骑手收紧一条松掉的带子时，那匹阿哈尔捷金马在敞开的门旁等着。

entries.en: We found a photograph of Akhisar inside the album's torn back cover.
entries.zh: 我们在相册破损的封底里面发现了一张阿克希萨的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 探测性针刺的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historian compared two early accounts of the akidopeirastic method.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家比较了两份早期关于探测性针刺法的记述。

entries.en: A portrait of Akihito hung above the display of historical photographs.
entries.zh: 明仁的一幅肖像挂在那组历史照片展品的上方。

entries.en: Because of her akinesthesia, she could not sense the movement of her hand during the examination.
entries.zh: 由于运动感觉缺失，她在检查时感觉不到自己手部的移动。

entries.en: He remained akinetic during the examination, although he appeared awake.
entries.zh: 检查时他仍不能自主活动，尽管看起来醒着。

entries.meaningZh: 七日热〔钩端螺旋体病的旧病名〕
entries.en: The historian borrowed two early reports on akiyami from the university archive.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家从大学档案馆借阅了两份关于七日热的早期报告。

entries.en: The lecturer pointed to Akkad on the historical map before moving to the next slide.
entries.zh: 讲师在历史地图上指出阿卡德的位置，然后切换到了下一张幻灯片。

entries.en: Her paternal grandfather's old travel diary included a sketch of Akkerman.
entries.zh: 她祖父的旧旅行日记中有一幅阿克曼的速写。

entries.en: The letter from Akkra contained a small pressed flower between its pages.
entries.zh: 从阿克拉寄来的信，信纸之间夹着一朵压干的小花。

entries.en: The aklomide analysis had to be repeated because the first vial had been mislabelled.
entries.zh: 阿克洛胺的分析必须重做，因为第一个小瓶的标签贴错了。

entries.en: A missing page prevented the historian from tracing the patient's account of aknephascopia.
entries.zh: 由于缺少一页，历史学家无法追溯患者关于黄昏盲的叙述。

entries.en: The botanist compared the Akokanthera specimens with drawings in an older flora.
entries.zh: 那位植物学家把箭毒木属的标本同一本旧植物志中的图画作了比较。

entries.en: The interview about akoria focused on her loss of satiety rather than her weight.
entries.zh: 那次有关不饱症的访谈主要谈了她失去饱腹感的情况，而不是她的体重。

entries.meaningZh: 习语器〔旧式听觉言语训练装置〕
entries.en: The curator could not display the akoulalion because its case had been damaged.
entries.zh: 那件旧式听觉言语训练装置的外壳损坏了，策展人无法将它展出。

entries.en: The historian placed an old akouphone beside several photographs of early hearing devices.
entries.zh: 历史学家把一件旧式助听器放在几张早期听觉辅助装置的照片旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 钴铬钨工具合金〔Akrit旧材料名〕
entries.en: The museum's Akrit tool was displayed beside the machinist's handwritten notebook.
entries.zh: 博物馆将那件钴铬钨工具合金制成的工具，陈列在机械工的手写笔记本旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 阿克罗佛林〔17-丙酸雌二醇的别名〕
entries.en: The akrofollin sample was set aside after the laboratory noticed a discrepancy in its paperwork.
entries.zh: 实验室发现文件记录不一致后，将那份阿克罗佛林样品单独搁置。

entries.meaningZh: 肢端巨大症〔旧词典拼法〕
entries.en: The lecturer compared two historical descriptions of akromegaly before examining the illustrations.
entries.zh: 讲师先比较了两份关于肢端巨大症的历史描述，再查看插图。

entries.meaningZh: 阿克苏姆〔埃塞俄比亚城镇名〕
entries.en: The letter from Aksum arrived with a photograph of the sender's garden.
entries.zh: 从阿克苏姆寄来的信附有一张寄信人花园的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 动作方式〔语言学：词汇体〕
entries.en: The seminar compared the Aktionsart of the two verbs rather than their past-tense forms.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了那两个动词的词汇体，而不是它们的过去式形式。

entries.en: The chemists disagreed about whether the new extract contained akuammicine.
entries.zh: 化学家们对这份新提取物是否含有阿枯米辛碱意见不一。

entries.en: The akuammine sample was too small for both laboratories to analyse independently.
entries.zh: 那份阿枯明样品太少，无法供两家实验室分别独立分析。

entries.en: He hung his rain-soaked Akubra on a porch hook instead of leaving it on the table.
entries.zh: 他把被雨淋湿的那顶“烤不赖”帽挂在门廊的挂钩上，没有把它放在桌上。

entries.meaningZh: 牛角瓜甾醇〔旧化学名称〕
entries.en: The old laboratory ledger recorded a second shipment of akundarol but no delivery date.
entries.zh: 旧实验室账簿记载了第二批牛角瓜甾醇，但没有交货日期。

entries.en: She filled an entire sketchbook during her stay in Akureyri but lost it on the journey home.
entries.zh: 她在阿库雷里逗留期间画满了一整本速写本，却在回家的路上弄丢了它。

entries.meaningZh: 阿克瓦弗莱克斯聚烯烃纤维
entries.en: The equipment list specified Akvaflex twine, but the delivery contained a different material.
entries.zh: 器材清单指定了阿克瓦弗莱克斯聚烯烃纤维捻线，但送来的却是另一种材料。

entries.en: The old travel journal described a delayed departure from Akyab without giving a reason.
entries.zh: 那本旧旅行日记记述了从阿恰布出发时的延误，却没有说明原因。

entries.meaningZh: 85号元素的旧拟名〔相关发现声称未获证实〕
entries.en: The historian compared the original claims about alabamium with later accounts of the search for element 85.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家把最初有关alabamium（85号元素的旧拟名）的说法，与后来寻找85号元素的记述作了比较。

entries.en: The laboratory checked the alachlor concentration in water collected from the drainage channel.
entries.zh: 实验室检测了从排水渠采集的水中甲草胺的浓度。

entries.en: Her alacrimia had been documented long before the appointment for her painful eyes.
entries.zh: 她的无泪症早在这次因眼痛就诊之前就有记录。

entries.meaningZh: 非乳酸性的〔旧运动生理学用语〕
entries.en: The older report gave separate estimates of alactacid and lactacid anaerobic capacity.
entries.zh: 那份较早的报告分别估算了非乳酸性和乳酸性无氧能力。

entries.en: Their family kept the postcards from Alagoas in a tin beside the radio.
entries.zh: 他们一家把来自阿拉戈斯的明信片放在收音机旁的铁盒里。

entries.en: A photograph of the Alai Mountains hung above the desk where she wrote her letters.
entries.zh: 她写信的那张书桌上方挂着一张阿莱山脉的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 不能说话的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The alalic patient wrote her questions on a small pad beside the bed.
entries.zh: 那位不能说话的患者把想问的问题写在床边的小记事本上。

entries.meaningZh: 阿勒曼尼人〔古代族群；复数〕
entries.en: The seminar compared two accounts of the Alamanni before turning to the maps.
entries.zh: 研讨课先比较了两份关于阿勒曼尼人的记述，然后转而研究地图。

entries.en: The student compared two alamethicin spectra before noticing that the axes used different scales.
entries.zh: 那个学生比较了两张丙甲菌素谱图，随后才注意到坐标轴使用了不同的刻度。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉明〔胺类制剂商品名〕
entries.en: The Alamine shipment arrived with one drum missing from the packing list.
entries.zh: 那批阿拉明到了，但装箱单上漏列了一桶。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉莫戈多〔美国城市名〕
entries.en: The parcel from Alamogordo was waiting on the doorstep when we got home.
entries.zh: 我们到家时，从阿拉莫戈多寄来的包裹已经放在门阶上了。

entries.en: The herbarium kept its older Alangiaceae folders apart from the updated catalogue.
entries.zh: 标本馆把较早的八角枫科档案夹与更新后的目录分开放置。

entries.en: They postponed the alangine analysis until the damaged instrument had been repaired.
entries.zh: 他们将八角枫碱的分析推迟至损坏的仪器修好之后。

entries.en: The alanosine reference vial was missing, leaving the second comparison unfinished.
entries.zh: 阿拉诺新对照品的小瓶不见了，第二次比较因此没有完成。

entries.en: The pharmacy museum displayed alant-camphor in a sealed jar beside an old weighing balance.
entries.zh: 药学博物馆在一架旧天平旁，展出了一罐密封保存的土木香脑。

entries.en: The chemist questioned the alantolactone identification because the second spectrum did not agree.
entries.zh: 化学家对土木香内酯的鉴定提出了疑问，因为第二张谱图与之不符。

entries.en: The student highlighted the alanyl group in the molecular drawing before explaining the linkage.
entries.zh: 学生先在分子结构图上突出标出了丙氨酰基，再解释其中的连接。

entries.en: The alanyl-leucine sample produced a faint signal that required a second measurement.
entries.zh: 那份丙氨酰亮氨酸样品产生的信号很弱，需要再测一次。

entries.en: The analyst compared the alanylglycine peak with the peak in the reference chromatogram.
entries.zh: 分析员把丙氨酰甘氨酸的峰与参考色谱图中的峰作了比较。

entries.en: Two laboratories reported different alanylhistidine concentrations for the same sample.
entries.zh: 两家实验室对同一样品报告的丙氨酰组氨酸浓度不同。

entries.en: The dressmaker found a spool of Alastra behind the heavier sewing threads.
entries.zh: 裁缝在较粗重的缝纫线后面发现了一轴阿拉斯特拉粘胶长丝。

entries.en: An Alawi reader asked the librarian to reserve the book until Friday.
entries.zh: 一位阿拉维派读者请图书管理员把那本书保留到周五。

entries.en: An Alawite in our discussion group lent me a book about local architecture.
entries.zh: 我们讨论组里的一位阿拉维派教徒借给我一本关于当地建筑的书。

entries.en: Alayne folded the letter twice before sliding it under the door.
entries.zh: 阿莱恩把信折了两次，才从门底下塞进去。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔瓦塞特市〔西班牙城市名〕
entries.en: We asked for directions to the city centre when we reached Albacete.
entries.zh: 我们到达阿尔瓦塞特市时，问了去市中心的路。

entries.en: The supplier sent two Albaloy samples, but only one matched the order number.
entries.zh: 供应商寄来了两份铜锡锌合金样品，但只有一份的编号与订单编号相符。

entries.en: The early report on albamyricetin left several questions about the material unanswered.
entries.zh: 那份关于白杨梅甙的早期报告没有回答有关这种物质的几个问题。

entries.en: The pharmacy museum received a sealed jar of albargin with its original paper wrapper.
entries.zh: 药学博物馆收到了一罐密封的明胶蛋白银，外面还包着原来的纸包装。

entries.en: The pharmacist found the albendazole entry on an older copy of the patient's medication list.
entries.zh: 药剂师在一份较早的患者用药清单上找到了阿苯达唑这一项。

entries.en: She put the Albene samples beside the other acetate fabrics before photographing them.
entries.zh: 拍照前，她把阿尔本醋酯纤维样品放在其他醋酯纤维织物旁边。

entries.en: The illustrator placed Alberich at the centre of the sketch, leaving space for the title.
entries.zh: 插画师把Alberich画在草图中央，留出了写标题的空间。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔伯特城〔伦敦文化区名称〕
entries.en: Our walking tour of Albertopolis ended when heavy rain sent everyone indoors.
entries.zh: 大雨让大家都躲进室内，我们在阿尔伯特城的步行游览也就结束了。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔必阶〔年代地层单位〕
entries.en: The researchers assigned the upper part of the formation to the Albian.
entries.zh: 研究者把这套地层的上部划归阿尔必阶。

entries.en: Albina left a bowl of cherries on the table for her guests.
entries.zh: 阿宾娜在桌上留了一碗樱桃给客人。

entries.en: The archive contains several case reports on albinismus, but most lack photographs.
entries.zh: 档案中有几份关于白化病的病例报告，但大多没有附照片。

entries.en: The animal's albinoism was described in an old field notebook, alongside a careful sketch.
entries.zh: 那本旧野外观察笔记记录了这只动物的白化情况，还配有一幅细致的素描。

entries.en: Albinoni wrapped the cracked cup carefully, hoping the repairer could still mend it.
entries.zh: 阿尔比诺尼小心地包好那只裂了的杯子，希望修理师傅还能把它修好。

entries.en: An older clinical report mentioned albinuria but gave no description of the urine sample.
entries.zh: 一份较早的临床报告提到了乳糜尿，却没有描述尿样。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔比翁期〔旧地层名称〕
entries.en: The historian compared two old accounts of the Albionian before checking their geological maps.
entries.zh: 历史学家先比较了两份关于阿尔比翁期的旧记述，再核查其中的地质图。

entries.en: The historian's chapter on albit was returned because several archival references were incomplete.
entries.zh: 历史学家撰写的关于氯酸盐炸药的章节被退回了，因为几条档案引用不完整。

entries.en: The laboratory postponed the albizziin comparison until the missing reference sample could be obtained.
entries.zh: 实验室推迟了合欢氨酸的比较分析，等待取得那份缺少的参比样品。

entries.en: She asked for the albizziine analysis to be repeated using a fresh reference sample.
entries.zh: 她要求用一份新的参比样品重新分析合欢氨酸。

entries.en: The old laboratory ledger recorded albocarbon under a different stock number.
entries.zh: 那本旧实验室账簿以另一个库存编号登记了萘。

entries.en: An extra peak in the albofungin chromatogram prompted another check for contamination.
entries.zh: 白真菌素色谱图中多出的一个峰促使他们再次检查是否有污染。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔博因〔伦巴第国王名〕
entries.en: The chapter on Alboin had several handwritten notes in its margins.
entries.zh: 介绍阿尔博因的那一章，页边有几条手写批注。

entries.meaningZh: 轻油乳剂〔Albolineum旧制剂商品名〕
entries.en: The faded Albolineum label was photographed for the museum's archive, but its date remained uncertain.
entries.zh: 那张褪色的轻油乳剂标签被拍照收入博物馆档案，但其日期仍无法确定。

entries.en: The researchers compared the alborixin extract with a reference sample before drawing a conclusion.
entries.zh: 研究者把白利辛霉素提取物与对照样品比较后，才下结论。

entries.en: The engineer checked the Albrac tube's order number before accepting the replacement.
entries.zh: 工程师核对了那根阿尔布拉克黄铜管的订单编号，才接收替换品。

entries.en: The chemist rejected the albucid results because the sample labels did not match the notebook.
entries.zh: 那位化学家没有接受磺乙酰胺的测定结果，因为样品标签与笔记本中的记录不符。

entries.en: The surgeon explained the proposed albugineotomy before asking the patient to sign the consent form.
entries.zh: 外科医生先解释了拟施行的白膜切开术，再请患者在同意书上签字。

entries.en: The specialist reviewed the earlier diagnosis of albuginitis before examining the new images.
entries.zh: 专科医生在查看新影像前，复核了先前的白膜炎诊断。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔布拉河〔瑞士河流名〕
entries.en: We watched the Albula from the bridge until the rain drove us back to the car.
entries.zh: 我们在桥上看着阿尔布拉河，直到下起雨来，才回到车里。

entries.en: The curator found a cracked albumimeter in a box of old laboratory equipment.
entries.zh: 策展人在一箱旧实验室器材中发现了一只开裂的白蛋白定量器。

entries.meaningZh: 血白蛋白含量〔此处不表示必然异常；英式拼法〕
entries.en: The original albuminaemia chart was missing, so the researcher could not verify the copied figures.
entries.zh: 原始血白蛋白含量图表不见了，因此研究人员无法核实抄录的数据。

entries.meaningZh: 白朊化物〔蛋白类衍生物〕
entries.en: The chemist recovered the albuminate precipitate and set it aside for further analysis.
entries.zh: 化学研究员收集了白朊化物沉淀，把它放在一旁以供进一步分析。

entries.en: The report compared the albuminates obtained from two different batches of material.
entries.zh: 报告比较了从两批不同材料中获得的清蛋白盐。

entries.meaningZh: 变性蛋白尿〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The physician requested another sample before confirming the old report of albuminaturia.
entries.zh: 在确认旧报告所记载的变性蛋白尿前，医生要求再取一份样本。

entries.meaningZh: 血白蛋白含量〔此处不表示必然异常〕
entries.en: The author omitted the units from the albuminemia table, leaving the editor unable to compare the figures.
entries.zh: 作者遗漏了血白蛋白含量表中的单位，导致编辑无法比较其中的数据。

entries.en: The anatomist examined the albuminiferous tissue through a microscope.
entries.zh: 解剖学家用显微镜观察了产生白蛋白的组织。

entries.en: The museum's albuminimeter had a damaged scale that was difficult to read.
entries.zh: 博物馆那台白蛋白定量器的刻度已经损坏，很难读清。

entries.en: The laboratory repeated the albuminimetry because the two measurements did not agree.
entries.zh: 由于两次测定结果不一致，实验室重新进行了白蛋白定量测定。

entries.en: Under magnification, the albuminiparous cells looked different from the surrounding tissue.
entries.zh: 在放大的视野下，产生白蛋白的细胞看起来与周围组织不同。

entries.meaningZh: 蛋白胆汁症〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: An old case report described albuminocholia without explaining how the bile had been examined.
entries.zh: 一份旧病例报告描述了蛋白胆汁症，却没有说明胆汁是如何检查的。

entries.en: The albuminofibrin preparation was discarded after the container broke during transport.
entries.zh: 容器在运输途中破裂后，那份纤维白蛋白样品被弃置了。
